title: fagelia parviflora
intro: Fagelia parviflora, commonly known as the Small-flowered Fagelia, is a plant species in the family Myoporaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fagelia parviflora include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its chemical composition.
